text:
frank (People Ops): Heads-up: several interviewers reported their interviewer kits (PDF + checklist) show as "Attachment truncated" on candidate pages. Happened for 3 hires this morning.
yasmin (Recruiter Ops): I saw this for candidate 8122. The PDF preview shows first page only and a red badge "incomplete upload". It used to be full.
lisa (Hiring Manager): we rely on those checklists during onsite; missing pages means missed context.
upload-bot: upload-service:post /uploads returned 413 Payload Too Large for file kit-8122.pdf (size 6.2MB) at 2259000900.
yasmin (Recruiter Ops): we did rotate to the new upload proxy last week. Maybe size limit is lower.
andre (Interview Eng): checking proxy config now. The proxy enforces a 5MB limit for multipart uploads by default; older uploads were stored via direct S3 presigned PUT which had 50MB. Looks like the migration toggled the proxy for "/assets/interviewer-kit/*" unintentionally.
frank (People Ops): urgent ask: can we restore previous behavior for interviewer-kit paths? We have panels in 6 hours.
andre (Interview Eng): short mitigation: allow resume uploads using presigned PUT for that path (bypass proxy) and add a banner on candidate page that says "If asset shows truncated, refresh after 10m or download from Admin > Interviewer Kits". Quick config flip, ~15m.
yasmin (Recruiter Ops): please also surface which candidate IDs were affected so we can re-send the full kit to interviewers.
andre (Interview Eng): added metric upload.proxy.rejected.size with candidate_id + filename (no file content). I can backfill for the last 12h and generate a list.
upload-bot: config-change:upload-proxy v1.3 rolled at 2259001150 by infra-bot.
andre (Interview Eng): presigned PUT fallback enabled at 2259001158. I've kicked a reattach job for the 3 affected uploads; will post when done.
yasmin (Recruiter Ops): reattach confirmed for 8122; preview shows full PDF. Sending quick note to interviewers now.
lisa (Hiring Manager): verified for candidate 8122. thanks. Please make the proxy change permanent for interviewer-kit and add a test case so future migrations don't flip it.
andre (Interview Eng): plan: 1) add integration test for asset upload paths, 2) update migration docs to call out exceptions, 3) keep presigned PUT for kit paths. Target release: 2259004800.
frank (People Ops): thanks. I'll draft an email template to notify interviewers and recruiters who might have missed context this morning.
yasmin (Recruiter Ops): template idea: "If you saw "Attachment truncated" on a candidate page, we've reattached the full kit. Refresh and reach out if still missing."
andre (Interview Eng): reattach job finished at 2259001210. 3 assets restored. Monitoring for more 413s.
upload-bot: incident created: UPLOAD-2026-19 "interviewer-kit-upload-truncated-by-proxy" assigned to andre.
